title: Mera aakhri salam
body:
khaiimey ke dar pe kehtaa haii bekas meraa imam
zahra sa ki betiyoon ko meraa aakhri salaam
rukhsat karo sab aake gareeb e ,batool ko
sauunpaa tumheeN khuda o ali o rasool ko
ab laut kar na aaega zakhmii sueey khayaam
hathoon mein shaam waale hai patthar ,liyee hueey
qaatil khadaa haii haathh mein khanjar liyee hueey
kuch deer me haii bass merii saansooN ka ikhtetaam
meeraaj mein rasool ne pehna thaa jo ,libaas
zainab pehnaa do misl e kafan aaj wo libaas
karnaa hai waqt e zibaah khudaa se hameeyy kalaam
ab tum ho bekasooN key ,liyee panjatan bahen
ayy bewatan akhii ki gareeb ulwatan bahen
sab ghar hai ab tumhaare hawaale ayy tasshna kaam
haii aakhrii hussain as kii gurbat ,ka imtehaan
tanhaa Ali ka laal hai laakhooN ke, darmiyaaN
maqtal mein ho gayaa hai shahadat ka imtehaan
baali sakiina gurbat e mazloom ,alwidaa
jaane do hum ko ayy merii maasoom alwidaa
zindaan mein aaeey gee tumheeyy leene hum ek shaam
apni lahed ko choord ke aaii, haiiN fatema
band e kafan ko todd ke aaii haiiN fatema
rotii hai ek nasheeb mein le lenke meraa naam
haayee wo waqqt e asrr takallum ,wo be kasii
tanhaiii parr hussain kii gurbat bhii roo padii
zainab badhhii haii thaamne rehwaar kii lagaam
